expected.description: Show a credible mobile Accounting workbench around a 390 CSS-pixel viewport with readable single-column hierarchy and no squeezed desktop table.
Keep the ledger visibly immutable and view-only, retain ledger version and as-of behavior, and avoid implying direct edits to posted history.
Preserve Draft, Submitted, Approved, and Posted document states and the evidence, review, approval, and posting priority without inventing unsupported operations.
Retain pending/proposed correction, reconciliation, period close, audit, and setup/context actions with explicit no-self-approval semantics and pending corrections having no ledger effect.
Preserve the baseline's quiet white card system, dark navy primary actions, green success states, amber pending state, compact typography, and restrained accounting tone.

prompts: Revise the existing Nivo Accounting workbench into a mobile layout around 390 CSS-pixel viewport intent. Preserve the design language, immutable ledger semantics, document statuses, accounting actions and their business priority; reorganize panels for a narrow screen and avoid squeezed desktop tables.

notes: The baseline is the selected current desktop surface and must be passed as the actual edit reference.

Source-grounding.md records the narrowly inspected frontend accounting workbench/copy and backend Accounting contract. The drawing is a design direction; controls and data remain native/live implementation concerns.

preserve: Preserve the Nivo Accounting workbench identity, restrained white card system, thin gray borders, compact sans-serif typography, dark navy primary actions, green applied/approved/posted states, and amber pending state.
Preserve the immutable view-only ledger model, Ledger v7, the VND balance, the as-of snapshot controls, and the separation between current and historical views.

Preserve the document lifecycle labels Draft, Submitted, Approved, and Posted, plus evidence intake, pending correction, correction proposal, reconciliation, period close, audit details, applied context, and accounting setup.
Preserve explicit four-eyes semantics: owner and financial approver remain distinct, approval is explicit, and no self-approval is implied.
Preserve the baseline sample amounts, dates, document names, classifications, owners, and status labels where they remain visible.
Preserve native-control and live-data intent; this image is a design direction, not evidence of implemented interaction.
change: Recompose the interface for a single 390 CSS-pixel-wide mobile viewport with comfortable touch targets, a clear vertical reading order, and scrollable page depth.
Replace the seven-column desktop document table with stacked document cards under horizontally scrollable status filters; never squeeze the desktop table into the narrow viewport.
Move the desktop right rail into the main flow as compact mobile cards or disclosure sections, surfacing the one pending correction before lower-priority setup details.
Group long forms into focused mobile action cards with full-width inputs and buttons while keeping destructive or unavailable period close visibly disabled until its prerequisite state is met.
